nodes.hint_edit: A radiology report counts as imaging. A pathology report on a biopsy or resection counts as histology. A biopsy or cytology report that calls the specimen inadequate or non-diagnostic counts as no tissue: pick from the other tiers.

options.label_head: A referral letter or clinical note only — no imaging report, no marker
options.rationale: Lowest tier: fits when no imaging, cytology or histology document is ticked, so it catches nothing ticked, a lone Lab Report, and IHC or Gene reports without the document they are read against (all understate, the safe direction).

options.label_head: An imaging report and a serum or cerebrospinal fluid alpha-fetoprotein
options.rationale: Needs the Imaging Report and the Lab Report (assumed to hold the alpha-fetoprotein or human chorionic gonadotropin result); the label's 'no tissue' excludes Cytology and Histology Report. The next node asks for the specific marker result.

options.label_head: An imaging report only — no marker result, no tissue
options.rationale: Imaging Report alone, honouring 'no marker result, no tissue' by excluding Lab Report, Cytology and Histology Report; sibling to option 1, so imaging with a Lab Report fits only option 1.

options.label_head: Cytology only — cerebrospinal fluid, effusion or fine-needle aspirate;
options.rationale: Needs the Cytology document itself (cerebrospinal-fluid cytology, effusion, aspirate); Histology Report excluded because the label says no tissue. IHC or genetics beside Cytology stays here (immunocytochemistry, no cell block named); imaging or lab beside Cytology also lands here.

options.label_head: A histology report — biopsy or resection
options.rationale: Histology Report ticked; the top tier regardless of other documents, with IHC and genetics refining it only beside the report.
